title: Deep neural network prediction of genome-wide transcriptome signatures - beyond the Black-box.
authors: Magnusson, Rasmus; Tegner, Jesper N; Gustafsson, Mika
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度神经网络从转录因子表达预测全基因组转录谱，虽涉及TF-基因调控关系，但核心是转录组预测而非TF-DNA结合位点或互作机制建模，方法可迁移但对象和互作轴匹配度中等。
abstract: Prediction algorithms for protein or gene structures, including transcription factor binding from sequence information, have been transformative in understanding gene regulation. Here we ask whether human transcriptomic profiles can be predicted solely from the expression of transcription factors (TFs). We find that the expression of 1600 TFs can explain >95% of the variance in 25,000 genes. Using the light-up technique to inspect the trained NN, we find an over-representation of known TF-gene regulations. Furthermore, the learned prediction network has a hierarchical organization. A smaller set of around 125 core TFs could explain close to 80% of the variance. Interestingly, reducing the number of TFs below 500 induces a rapid decline in prediction performance. Next, we evaluated the prediction model using transcriptional data from 22 human diseases. The TFs were sufficient to predict the dysregulation of the target genes (rho = 0.61, P < 10(-216)). By inspecting the model, key causative TFs could be extracted for subsequent validation using disease-associated genetic variants. We demonstrate a methodology for constructing an interpretable neural network predictor, where analyses of the predictors identified key TFs that were inducing transcriptional changes during disease.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质或基因结构的预测算法，包括从序列信息预测转录因子结合，已在理解基因调控方面产生了变革性影响。在此，我们探讨是否仅凭转录因子（TFs）的表达就能预测人类转录组谱。我们发现，1600个转录因子的表达可以解释25,000个基因中>95%的方差。利用光启技术检查训练后的神经网络（NN），我们发现已知的转录因子-基因调控关系被过度代表。此外，学习到的预测网络具有层级组织结构。一个约125个核心转录因子的较小集合能解释接近80%的方差。有趣的是，将转录因子数量减少至500以下会导致预测性能迅速下降。接下来，我们使用来自22种人类疾病的转录数据评估了预测模型。转录因子足以预测靶基因的失调（rho = 0.61，P < 10(-216)）。通过检查模型，可以提取关键因果转录因子，用于后续使用疾病相关遗传变异进行验证。我们展示了一种构建可解释神经网络预测器的方法，其中对预测器的分析识别出在疾病期间诱导转录变化的关键转录因子。
